baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparison joins يعلم/الحق, أعمى, and يتذكر within 13:19.
baseline_models.mechanism: Knowledge is disclosure of fixed reality; inward blindness blocks that disclosure, while recollection brings an already held object back into presence. The exclusive particles frame opposed cognitive operations rather than different amounts of information.

activation_trace.role: Literal disclosure to a knower supplies the event that defines knowing here.
Literal stability matching reality makes the disclosed object resistant to subjective revision.
Literal blindness of heart supplies the blocked inward faculty opposed to disclosure.
Literal re-presentation after forgetfulness supplies the recovery operation reserved for possessors of cores.

changed_reading.before: The ayah contrasts an informed person with a blind person and praises thoughtful remembrance.
changed_reading.after: It contrasts reality becoming inwardly disclosed and re-presented with a heart whose perceptual operation is blocked.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أنما أنزل إليك من ربك الحق is set against blindness in 13:19.
baseline_models.mechanism: The truth is delivered and placed, then known by its distinguishing marks and fit; blindness is spatialized as failure to find a way through unknown terrain. Knowing is successful orientation to received material, not bare assent to a proposition.

activation_trace.role: Literal delivery and arrival make revelation something that must actually reach the addressee.
Literal placement in a proper station makes reception an act of fitting the delivered matter where it belongs.
Literal congruence with a joint or holder supplies truth's fit to its proper locus.
A literal distinguishing mark that guides turns knowing into navigation by evidence.
Literal unmapped terrain in which guidance fails spatializes the blind comparator.

changed_reading.before: Knowing means agreeing that the revelation is true.
changed_reading.after: Knowing means receiving, fitting, and navigating by the descended truth; blindness is failed orientation even when the material is present.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence من ربك الحق ... يتذكر أولو الألباب links source, truth, recollection, and holders of cores.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-distant legal register makes recollection the recovery of a preserved claim or pledge and lets the possessors of cores trace it toward its consequence. This is a cross-branch activation, not a replacement gloss for the surface words.

activation_trace.role: A literal covenant branch within the Lord-root activates obligation in the source relation.
A literal reality or claim requiring preservation gives the truth something to be kept intact.
A literal written instrument of a right turns recollection into recovery of an accountable claim.
Literal return to an outcome supplies the consequential horizon of those designated أولو.

changed_reading.before: People of understanding mentally recall a teaching.
changed_reading.after: Holders of cores recover and preserve a binding truth while reading it toward its outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:1 repeats the focus claim before contrasting it with widespread non-belief. The focus question therefore tests recognition of an already announced reality: delivery and truth do not automatically become settled trust.

activation_trace.role: Focus disclosure anchors the delta in the act of knowing.
Repeated literal delivery establishes that the same revealed object was already presented.
Repeated literal reality-stability fixes the object of the later recognition question.
Literal heart-settling assent supplies the response that the majority withhold despite delivery.

structural_cues: 13:1 repeats the focus clause nearly verbatim and appends a majority non-belief contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition plus the belief contrast; I infer that repetition turns يعلم into tested recognition rather than first exposure; alternatively 13:1 may only state the surah thesis without specifying the focus mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus introduces a new claim for a knower to understand.
changed_reading.after: The focus asks who recognizes as truth what has already been delivered and stated, despite a social field of non-assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sign sequence couples visible marks with separating boundaries, repeated deliberation, and an intellect that restrains ignorance. In 13:19, knowing the truth becomes disciplined discrimination of varied effects without losing their common source.

activation_trace.role: The focus mark that distinguishes and guides anchors knowledge as patterned reading.
Literal separation that reveals a boundary supplies the discriminating operation.
Literal visible marks provide the field on which discrimination works.
Literal recurrent movement of the heart supplies sustained comparison rather than a single glance.
Literal restraint from ignorance supplies the governing discipline of the possessors of cores.

structural_cues: 13:2-4 move from detailed signs to paired and adjacent forms, then to different produce nourished by one water.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visible marks, separation, deliberation, restraint, and one-source differentiation; I infer that these operations define the focus knower; alternatively the sequence may simply accumulate proofs without prescribing a cognitive method.

changed_reading.before: Knowing is possession of the correct proposition.
changed_reading.after: Knowing is the restrained ability to separate, compare, and read differentiated outcomes as marks of one ordering truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact blind-seeing comparison in 13:16 sits inside a test of whether fabricated partners can be confused with the sole creator. The focus opposition therefore concerns causal discrimination: sight detects the non-equivalence that superficial resemblance obscures.

activation_trace.role: Focus inward blindness anchors the comparison as a cognitive faculty failure.
The repeated literal loss of sight makes the focus comparison an explicit local refrain.
Literal heart-insight supplies the positive faculty omitted but implied in the focus.
Literal confusion caused by resemblance supplies the error that inward sight must undo.

structural_cues: 13:16 pairs blind/seeing and darkness/light inside questions about creator and partners.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated comparison and a creator-confusion frame; I infer that sight in 13:19 is causal discrimination; alternatively the analogies may condemn unbelief generally without assigning this specific operation.

changed_reading.before: The blind comparator merely lacks understanding.
changed_reading.after: The blind comparator cannot break a false equivalence between derivative appearances and the singular source that gives them being.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 13:17, descending input enters channels according to capacity; agitation raises conspicuous foam, while the useful material remains and the unstable false layer is expelled. Anchored to أنزل and الحق, 13:19 becomes an assay of what settles and benefits rather than what dominates the surface.

activation_trace.role: Focus reality-stability anchors the assay's retained material as truth.
Literal descent and settling connect the parable's input to the focus revelation.
A literal valley as a flood channel supplies differently capacitated receivers.
Literal floating froth supplies salient but non-retained surface material.
Literal loss of truth and stability identifies the layer that fails the assay.
Literal stable remaining under delay supplies the temporal test for useful truth.

structural_cues: 13:17 runs parallel water and smelting processes, then explicitly contrasts truth/falsehood and departing/remaining.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies descent, capacity, froth, falsehood, and remaining; I infer an epistemic filter from salience to durable benefit; alternatively the parable may describe social endurance rather than the individual cognition of 13:19.

changed_reading.before: The knower identifies a true statement.
changed_reading.after: The knower assays received material, refusing floating excess and recognizing truth by fit, persistence, and benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The relative-clause chain after 13:19 unfolds أولو الألباب as people who complete a covenant, join what must be joined, restrain themselves, sustain worship and expenditure, repair harm, and refuse severance. Cognition becomes enacted fidelity and relational maintenance.

activation_trace.role: The focus document-of-right branch anchors recollection as accountable preservation.
Literal completion without deficiency supplies faithful execution rather than mental assent.
A literal preserved covenant names the obligation maintained by the knower.
A literal confirmed compact supplies the binding strength of that obligation.
Literal joining until attachment turns insight into repair of commanded relations.
Literal restraint of the self supplies the durability required for enacted knowledge.
Literal severing of connection supplies the inverse behavior that exposes blindness.

structural_cues: 13:20-24 grammatically continue the referent of أولو الألباب through coordinated relative clauses.
The uncatalogued د ر ء occurrence at 13:22[13] structurally adds repelling evil with good; no branch is invented for it.
13:25 reverses the chain through breaking, cutting, and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a grammatical continuation, maintenance acts, a branchless repair cue, and their reversal; I infer these are diagnostics of the focus cognition; alternatively they may be consequences of understanding rather than constituents of it.

changed_reading.before: People of cores are an intellectual class who understand revelation.
changed_reading.after: People of cores make truth legible by completing bonds, maintaining relations, restraining themselves, and repairing rather than severing.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:28 repeats remembrance as the operation by which hearts become still, while the heart inventory itself opens a core or pure-center image. The focus يتذكر أولو الألباب is thus a recurrent stabilization practice that brings the heart back to its core.

activation_trace.role: Focus re-presentation supplies the repeated remembrance operation.
Literal heart-security supplies the receptive condition paired with remembrance.
Repeated literal stillness makes remembrance a stabilizing process rather than a passing thought.
The literal pure core of a thing supplies a context bridge to the uncatalogued focus الألباب.
Repeated contextual re-presentation shows the operation acting twice upon the heart.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats both remembrance and heart-settling; the focus root ل ب ب has no branch inventory and is used only through its surface core construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated remembrance, repeated settling, and a heart-as-core branch; I infer a return-to-center mechanism; alternatively tranquility may be an effect of remembrance without defining the focus act of recollection.

changed_reading.before: يتذكر denotes a moment of remembering by intelligent people.
changed_reading.after: يتذكر denotes recurrent re-centering that quiets the heart until its core can hold the disclosed truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:31 imagines recitation moving mountains, splitting earth, or addressing the dead, yet reserves guidance to divine agency. Against that counterfactual spectacle, focus blindness is not a shortage of dramatic external evidence but failure of inward orientation.

activation_trace.role: Focus inward blindness anchors the failure as internal rather than optical scarcity.
Literal recitation supplies the revelatory medium assigned spectacular effects in the counterfactual.
A literal high solid mass supplies the extreme object supposedly displaced.
Literal cleaving supplies the second maximal outward effect.
Literal loss of life supplies the third limit case for outward proof.
Literal gentle direction to the true path distinguishes guidance from spectacular causation.

structural_cues: 13:31 forms a three-part لو counterfactual, then pivots with بل to divine command and guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies impossible-scale effects followed by a guidance pivot; I infer that spectacle is insufficient for the focus sight; alternatively the counterfactual may praise the revelation's power without contrasting spectacle and cognition.

changed_reading.before: Blindness would be cured by stronger evidence.
changed_reading.after: Even overwhelming outward effects do not constitute the inward guidance by which the descended truth is known.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:36 contrasts joy in what was sent down with factions that make part of it unrecognized. The focus أنما أنزل ... الحق can therefore diagnose selective partition: blindness may preserve preferred pieces while disabling recognition of the received whole.

activation_trace.role: Focus delivery anchors the object whose integrity is at issue.
Repeated literal delivery identifies the same received object as the site of divided response.
A literal separated portion supplies the partitioning mechanism within factional reception.
Literal alteration into something unknown or disliked supplies active de-recognition of a portion.
Literal division into a part fixes the selective scope of denial.

structural_cues: 13:36 directly opposes rejoicing in the revealed object to denial whose grammatical object is بعضه.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies whole reception, faction, de-recognition, and a partitive object; I infer that the focus knower preserves integral recognition; alternatively 13:36 may concern communities' positions rather than an individual's cognitive partitioning.

changed_reading.before: A person either knows the revelation or is wholly blind to it.
changed_reading.after: Blindness can operate selectively by partitioning revelation and making an inconvenient portion unrecognizable while retaining the rest.

context_deltas.mechanism: 13:37 weakens any simple equation of possessed knowledge with sight: an articulated, adjudicative revelation has arrived, yet inclination can still be followed after knowledge. The focus blind pole can therefore include chosen orientation, not only missing cognition.

activation_trace.role: A literal branch of deliberate choosing gives the focus blind pole a volitional edge.
Literal accurate wisdom or knowledge supplies the adjudicative quality of what arrived.
Literal articulation and clarification remove obscurity as the primary cause of failure.
Literal following supplies the directional act taken after clarification.
Literal self-inclination supplies the competing vector that bends conduct away from known judgment.
Contextual disclosure explicitly precedes the warned-against following, proving that information alone is insufficient.

structural_cues: The temporal construction بعدما جاءك من العلم places following desire after the arrival of knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarified judgment, subsequent knowledge, and a competing inclination; I infer a chosen reversal from disclosed truth; alternatively the warning may be hypothetical and not define the blind person in 13:19.

changed_reading.before: Once truth is known, blindness is simply absent information.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge can be present while self-inclination redirects following; blindness may be a chosen orientation after disclosure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing verse couples sufficient witness, relation between disputants, and knowledge of the book. This sharpens focus knowing into accountable, text-grounded discrimination that can stand between parties, not merely private certainty.

activation_trace.role: Focus disclosure anchors the closing public form of knowledge.
Literal performance until sufficiency supplies an evidentiary threshold.
Literal declaration grounded in knowledge turns knowing into witness-bearing.
Literal clarification by speech or sign supplies adjudication between opposed parties.
Repeated contextual disclosure attaches knowledge directly to the book.
Literal ordered writing supplies the durable textual object of that knowledge.

structural_cues: The finale coordinates divine witness with the one who has knowledge of the book in a dispute over messengerhood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficiency, witness, between-ness, and book-knowledge; I infer a public evidentiary function for the focus knower; alternatively the divine witness and book-knower may remain separate attestations without defining knowledge itself.

changed_reading.before: Knowing the truth is an inward state.
changed_reading.after: Knowing the truth can become sufficient witness: a book-grounded capacity to clarify what stands between rival claims.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a prayer simile onto cognition. It remains valid because the focus says the truth was sent to the addressee while 13:14 stages truth-associated water that never reaches the mouth; downstream prose should present it only as an embodied reception analogy, not a lexical equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The arrival phrase أنزل إليك and the knowing/blind contrast permit a reception-success question.

activation_trace.role: Focus delivery establishes an input intended to reach an addressee.
Literal stable truth labels the call surrounding the failed transfer image.
Literal extension of the hand supplies an outward reaching gesture.
The literal palm supplies the receiver that cannot complete transfer.
Literal water supplies available content that remains external.
Repeated literal reaching to a goal marks the circuit's intended and failed completion.
The literal open mouth supplies the inward destination that the water never reaches.

changed_reading.before: Exposure to revelation is equivalent to receiving it.
changed_reading.after: A person may reach outward toward truth while the transfer never becomes inward reception; the focus knower completes that circuit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 13:39 concerns divine erasure and confirmation, not ordinary human memory. It remains anchored through focus recollection and fixed truth plus the context's stable proof and gathering source; downstream prose should mark it as a structural analogy, not assign divine revision to the rememberer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يتذكر and الحق anchor a question about what recollection preserves as stable.

activation_trace.role: Focus re-presentation supplies the human memory operation under examination.
Focus reality-stability supplies the object memory must track.
Literal loss of a trace supplies the negative operation against indiscriminate retention.
Literal proof and confirmation supply the criterion for what remains cognitively authoritative.
A literal origin, collector, and reference point supplies the stable substrate behind changing traces.
Literal inscription that establishes judgment supplies durable determination rather than mere storage.

changed_reading.before: Good recollection retains as much prior material as possible.
changed_reading.after: Good recollection may be discriminative: it releases erased traces and returns to what is confirmed against a stable source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads territorial edge-loss as an epistemic operation. It remains anchored because 13:41 opens with seeing and couples edge-reduction to unreviewable judgment, while the focus opposes knowing to blindness; downstream prose should qualify it as a subtraction analogy, not a claim about the verse's primary geography.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يعلم versus أعمى allows contexts that ask whether reduction can itself become visible evidence.

activation_trace.role: The focus guiding mark anchors subtraction as something potentially read.
Focus loss of orientation in unknown terrain makes changing boundaries cognitively relevant.
Literal ocular and inward seeing explicitly invites perception of the process.
Literal loss of part of a thing supplies subtraction as the revealing event.
A literal edge or endpoint locates where the reduction becomes legible.
Repeated literal judgment supplies the irreversible ordering disclosed through that reduction.

changed_reading.before: Truth is known through added disclosure and accumulated signs.
changed_reading.after: Truth may also become legible by subtraction at the edges: loss reveals an ordering that surface abundance had concealed.

strongest_changes: The exact 13:1 reprise turns the focus from first exposure into recognition under conditions of non-assent.
The 13:17 water-and-smelting sequence turns knowing into an assay of durable benefit against salient foam.
The 13:20-25 continuation turns people of cores from an intellectual label into covenantal and relational practice.
The 13:37 after-knowledge warning preserves a live distinction between disclosed knowledge and chosen orientation.
summary.what_was_special: The focus behaves as a hinge: earlier perception and material processes specify how truth is discriminated, while later relative clauses and reversals specify how it is embodied or resisted. These mechanisms coexist rather than collapse into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The covenantal baseline depends on branch-distant activations in ر ب ب, ح ق ق, ذ ك ر, and ء و ل and should remain exploratory.
13:31 may contrast spectacle with guidance, or may only assert divine command while praising revelatory power.
The 13:39 and 13:41 analogies are traceable but sufficiently cross-domain that downstream prose should keep their containment explicit.
